revisions.title: The mother’s nourishment
revisions.body: The passage reverses the usual parent–child relation: the mother nourishes those who belong to her, making civic identity a relation of dependence rather than a simple legal label.

revisions.title: Education as Civic Formation
revisions.body: Education matters here not as another item in the city’s self-description, but as the point at which inherited civic standing must become lived character.

revisions.title: Athens as a refuge
revisions.body: The passage should not be inflated into a scene of former enemies coming to beg. Keep its narrower emphasis on the need of named Greeks and the King for Athens and on their seeking salvation there.
